reproduced_defects.summary: Featured 50/50 bookmaker tie (Thunderpick 1.85 / 1.85, pick_index: null) skipped alias-aware money origination in scripts/originate.py because featured.get('method') != 'model', omitting Polymarket event 1200431 ('FURIA vs Aurora Gaming', bid 0.52/0.47, ask 0.53/0.48 -> [0.525, 0.475]) and Kalshi event KXCS2GAME-26OCT171000AURFURIA (bid 0.52/0.47, ask 0.53/0.48 -> [0.525, 0.475]).
reproduced_defects.fix: Extend live_collect and resolve_match in scripts/originate.py and validate_origination in scripts/build_origination.py so an equal-estimate featured tie (pick_index is None) runs alias-aware money origination and upgrades when a directional money-backed estimate is verified.

reproduced_defects.summary: In scripts/build_strategy.py line 222, a 50/50 row with pick_index is None defaulted to fav = 0 ('FURIA') and dog = 1 ('Aurora'), turning an equal 50/50 tie with no directional pick into an arbitrary 'Upset play' (swap: true, default: 1 'Aurora', cost: 0.0).
reproduced_defects.fix: Set fav = None, dog = None, default = None and add blocker 'equal 50/50 line (no favorite or underdog)' when probs[0] == probs[1] and pick_index not in (0, 1).
